caption: The drawing depicts a single clay pot with a short, thick spout on the right side and a small loop handle on the left. The pot is illustrated in shades of reddish-brown, with some darker and lighter areas indicating texture and wear. The surface of the pot includes imperfections and variations in color, suggesting signs of use and age. There are faint horizontal lines around the body of the vessel, giving it a sense of dimensionality and shape. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, with no other objects or designs present, focusing attention solely on the pot.
